title: Compensation at the Store
objective: Apply compensation inside a real, motivating context (totaling a small receipt) — the unit's, and Foundation Release 1's, capstone application lesson.
studentQuestion: How much did we spend in all — is there a friendlier way to add it up?

teaching.setup: A short receipt: two items priced $19 and $26.
teaching.see: How much did both items cost together?
teaching.break: Notice $19 is close to $20; round up and plan to correct.
teaching.transform: $19 + $26 and $20 + $26 - $1 — same total ($45), reached via a friendlier round number.

check.prompt: Add the original prices directly to confirm $45.

examples.transfer: A three-item receipt, applying compensation to whichever price is closest to a landmark.

mastery.evidence: Correctly totals 2 receipt-style problems using compensation, including the correction step, in a real-context wrapper.
